name: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.3
changelog: Hiragana Road Fighter: Remastered Edition v1.0.3! Features dynamic 3D drop shadows across all background scenery and vehicles: deciduous trees with dual-layer soft penumbra/umbra, radiating starburst shadows for beach palms, tiered conical shadows for alpine and snow pines, dense contact shadows for boulders, spires, and lanterns, and suspension drop shadows for player and traffic vehicles.
